description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Badagamuwa, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District  - Cad. Map No. 420211
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land (including parcel numbers, extent, owner details, title class, and encumbrances) in the Kurunegala District. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
